reviews.title: Just go for it
reviews.body: The Native M2 Pro looks premium and the water quality is excellent, no more salty taste. Installation by Urban Company was super fast, neat and very professional. The service engineer was polite and explained all features clearly. Truly a 5-star product with 5-star service, highly recommended!

reviews.title: Absolute game-changer for home water purification!
reviews.body: I recently got the Urban Company Native M2 Pro installed, and I am thoroughly impressed. The build quality feels solid and premium compared to standard plastic purifiers. What stands out the most is the smart app connectivity—being able to monitor TDS levels, water quality, and filter health directly from my phone gives complete peace of mind. The water tastes fresh, crisp, and naturally balanced, thanks to the mineral and copper cartridge. Knowing that it logs local data even without a permanent Wi-Fi connection is a brilliant feature.
